title: Playbook applied — 3 lessons
detail:
• [workspace-rule] Index page.json is un-editable via Buildprint — Any edit to the index page's page.
  FIX: Any edit to the index page's page.json — even one character — trips a pre-existing blocking check error (canvas-root-name-validity: 'index' is a reserved name). Never rename index (required to run the app) and never plan page-level edits on it; page-scoped changes need another mechanism (e.g. per-element states or a reusable).
• [design-pattern] CRS light-mode pattern: bptheme element states — Theming is per-element conditional states keyed on Current User's dark_theme is_false, overriding colors with the paired '· Light' tokens from tokens.
  FIX: Theming is per-element conditional states keyed on Current User's dark_theme is_false, overriding colors with the paired '· Light' tokens from tokens.json (e.g. BG Secondary ↔ BG Secondary · Light). Copy the pattern from existing elements (e.g. Toast); never edit shared style files for one page — that leaks to every page using the style.
• [decision-pointer] Anonymous sign-in page is dark BY DESIGN — Vlad ruled 2026-07-19: the index/sign-in page renders dark for logged-out visitors — intended behavior, never a bug to fix.
  FIX: Vlad ruled 2026-07-19: the index/sign-in page renders dark for logged-out visitors — intended behavior, never a bug to fix. Light mode there activates only for logged-in users with dark_theme = no. Verify index light mode logged-in; never propose anonymous-theme workarounds unless Vlad reopens the decision (see decisions.md 2026-07-19).

detail:
• [platform-gotcha] When buildprint sync fails with Unauthorized, don't assume stale data — check sync status first; if workspace matches latest snapshot, the error is transient auth, not staleness.

  FIX: Use `buildprint utils generate-ids <count>` (e.g., `buildprint utils generate-ids 4`), not `--count`.

detail:
• [platform-gotcha] Node.js rejects unknown double-dash options with exit code 9 before any script loads; use `node --help` or `node --version` to verify available flags.
  FIX: Inspect available flags with `node --help` or `node --v8-options`; verify binary works with `node --version`; unknown flags cause hard exit 9, not a runtime error in your script.

detail:
• [cli-bug] buildprint has no 'status' command; use 'buildprint project list' or 'buildprint link' to test connection.
  FIX: Run `buildprint project list` to diagnose connectivity; it will either succeed or fail with the actual error (e.g., token revoked).

detail:
• [platform-gotcha] MCP connectors for external services (Gmail, Google Drive, etc.) require explicit permission grant from the user's Claude interface before the tool can execute — the assistant cannot proceed and must request user approval.
  FIX: When a tool call returns permission denied, look for a permission dialog in your Claude interface and click Allow (or Always Allow). If no prompt appears, check whether your client has permissions auto-denied in settings. After approval, retry the operation.

title: Learned 2 lessons
detail:
• [platform-gotcha] Connecting an OAuth service (e.g., Gmail) and granting per-tool permissions in Claude Code are two separate configuration gates; one does not automatically enable the other.
  FIX: After OAuth connection, explicitly grant tool permissions via Claude Code settings or by responding to tool-permission prompts when a tool-use attempt surfaces them. Retry the tool call after granting.
• [platform-gotcha] Permission dialogs for MCP tools may surface as out-of-band UI elements (banners, notifications, pending-action buttons) rather than inline chat messages, depending on the client.
  FIX: After a tool call fails with a permission error, check for permission dialogs outside the chat window (notification center, pending-actions area, settings panel) in addition to in-chat messages, then retry.
